headline: This 2021 McLaren 765LT with Roof Scoop is Now Available at duPont REGISTRY Select!
overview: Finished in McLaren Orange over a Black Alcantara interior with McLaren Orange stitching, this highly optioned 765LT features one of the most impressive specifications we've seen. Highlights include the MSO Clubsport Pro Pack, Carbon Fiber Exterior Upgrade Pack 2, MSO Defined Carbon Fiber Rear Aero Bridge, Carbon Fiber Diffuser, and additional carbon fiber options throughout. A standout option is the $36,340 Gloss Black Roof Scoop, one of the most notable factory options available for the 765LT. Showing just 8,000 miles and protected by Full-Body PPF, this example has been well preserved. At its heart is a 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8 producing 755 horsepower, paired with extensive weight reduction and advanced aerodynamics. With its raw performance and limited production, the 765LT has become one of the most desirable modern McLarens among enthusiasts and collectors.
